blocking_findings: ADV-3 [Blocker] adversarial: the AC-24 eligibility check of www-tutor-reedy-claim.test.tsx misses three reversals of the active-package rule. eligibilityBreaks copies NEGATION_PATTERNS, INACTIVE_PATTERNS, and ACTIVE_WORD; a temporary edit of the shipped test proved with three failing probes that 'Open to students with a non-active class package, on lessons they finished.' and the in-active variant return an empty break list, because /\bno\b/ has no word boundary inside 'non' and /\binactive\b/ does not match the hyphenated forms, while /\bactive\b/ still matches. A Thai cancelled-package sentence 'ยกเลิกแพ็กเกจคลาสที่ใช้งานอยู่' also returns an empty break list, because INACTIVE th only lists /ไม่ใช้งาน/ and NEGATION th only lists /ไม่/ and /ทุกคน/. The shipped en/th/zh copy is clean today, so the suite is green, but a future edit can reverse the rule inside the checked strings without a failure. Route-to-Green: widen INACTIVE_PATTERNS (for example a hyphenated in-active/non-active pattern for en and a cancelled-package pattern for th) or otherwise make these probes break. The committed failing probe file is src/__tests__/reedy-inactive-reversal.adversarial.test.tsx; it copies the shipped pattern sets and asserts each reversal is rejected.
